data.name: Nafish
data.gender_notes: Nafish is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Symbolizing the divine presence in water, Nafish is a name inspired by Hindu mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit term 'Nava-shya', meaning 'new fish', this name is believed to bring prosperity and success. The name Nafish carries the meaning “Fish in water” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nafish usually hope their child will grow to embody fish in water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine presence and prosperity
data.etymology: Nafish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fish in water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafish total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nafish holds cultural significance in the Hindu community as it represents the divine presence in water. In Hindu mythology, water is considered sacred and has a symbolic significance in various rituals and practices. Nafish, being derived from the Sanskrit term 'Nava-shya' or 'new fish', represents new beginnings and prosperity. Fish symbolize fertility, abundance, and renewal of life, attributes that are highly revered in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Nafish carries the essence of the divine presence. In Hinduism, water is a symbol of purity and life force, and the name Nafish signifies being immerse in the divine essence of life. It is believed that the person with the name Nafish embodies the qualities of a renewed being, marked by their new beginnings and the blessings of the Hindu deities. Overall, Nafish is a name that inspires a connection to the divine and the natural world through the power of water.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Nafish in Hindu tradition is believed to represent the divine essence of inner wisdom and intuition. It symbolizes one's connection to the cosmic consciousness and the ability to discern truth.
